message: Quick add now reads a time and a part of the day together. "Dinner tomorrow night at 8pm" lands tomorrow instead of today, "tonight at 9:30" means 9:30 PM, and "game night friday" keeps "night" in the title. "At midnight" now means tonight, "every day starting tomorrow at 9am" keeps its repeat, and "feb 29" waits for the next leap year.
